subject: SFDC rolling cleanse: ownership checkpoint & stale-opps sweep
body:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SFDC rolling cleanse: ownership checkpoint & stale-opps sweep

Team —

Quick rolling-cleanse request for Aperture Health (deal APHT-8397). Finance asked we run a short hygiene sweep today to make sure stage and close dates reflect where these opportunities actually are. I pulled the attached Aperture_Opps_Report_Q3.csv with opportunities flagged as 60+ days of no activity or mismatch between stage and expected close.

Can each owner do a 10-min pass on the list below and reply here with one of three outcomes:
- Confirm (update stage/close in SFDC)
- At risk (set next step + updated close)
- Archive/Park (if truly dead, mark as "Parked" and leave reason)

Priority items for this sweep:
1) APHT-8397 — SOW under review, multiple contacts; SFDC close date shows 2027-08-31 but procurement timeline slipped.
2) APHT-8421 — No owner update in 75 days; stage = Proposal.
3) APHT-8474 — Legal redline pending; rep marked as active but no sign-offs.

Attachments: Aperture_Opps_Report_Q3.csv (csv) and SOW_draft_v2.pdf (pdf).

As a reminder: if we don't get a definitive confirm/ownership action in 48 hours, Finance will default stale opps to "Parked" for the quarter close — which affects commit. If you need me to make the SFDC change for you, reply with the desired stage/date and I'll apply.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

---

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SFDC rolling cleanse: ownership checkpoint & stale-opps sweep

Thanks Rachel — jumping on APHT-8397 and APHT-8421. Quick notes:
- APHT-8397: I'm the active owner; procurement emailed on Friday saying they expect to complete PO routing next week, but legal needs one more signature (we have an updated SOW attached after the last redline). I will move stage to "Contract" and set close to 2027-09-10 unless Samir pushes earlier.
- APHT-8421: I can't find a recent contact thread; I'll ping the champion but tentatively propose marking as "Parked" + note "no response to outreach".

Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 16:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SFDC rolling cleanse: ownership checkpoint & stale-opps sweep

Thanks all — good progress. Consolidating next steps so Finance/Leadership have a single source of truth: 

- APHT-8397 (Ben): Update SFDC stage to "Contract" and set close date to 2027-09-15 (per Samir). Ben — please add a one-line note in the opportunity comments: "Procurement PO routing in progress; vendor PO attached; legal sign-off pending confirmation." I'll attach PO to the HubSpot record as well.
- APHT-8421 (Ben): Please confirm outreach outcome by EOD tomorrow. If no reply, change stage to "Parked" and set reason = "no response to outreach - hygiene sweep 2027-08-09."
- APHT-8474 (Marissa): Please move to "Legal Review" and update next step + expected close if you have dates.

I've attached the PO and pushed the HubSpot opportunity link here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/8901/opportunity/8397. Also pasted the SFDC record for quick access: https://redwood.salesforce.com/5001N00001XYZ.

If any owner wants me to perform the SFDC update, reply with the specific stage/date and I'll update (I have edit rights). Final note for the group: Finance will consider anything still flagged as "No update" after 48 hours as "Parked" for the quarter close. Let's avoid unnecessary archiving by confirming early.

Thanks — appreciate the quick pass.
Rachel
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
